fields.why: The Table shows 2016 use for four race/ethnicity groups side by side; the text's only race claims are Hispanic vs non-Hispanic white (pairwise), so 'no entry' under rule 1 is the other defensible reading.
Race/ethnicity is the only SPD with 3+ groups; sex and school level are two-level, and the trend model only adjusts for race, sex and grade.
No test across race groups is stated (t-tests are for 2015 vs 2016 only), so the four-group display is side by side; resolves_to_finer true is supported by the Hispanic vs white contrast.
